inputs.text: The owner of Blue Waters has said that the government collects taxes from them “without doing or investing in anything.” This complaint really exposes how corporations resist accountability for the plastic bottles found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains. It underscores the structural problem where big business externalizes its costs onto the rest of society, piling environmental harm onto vulnerable groups who already face the worst effects of inequality and lack the power to demand better. We need real institutional reform so taxes actually force companies to fund protections and cleanup instead of letting profits come before people and the planet.
